title: iActions [Drunk+] for SkyrimNet
tagline: NPC drinking, intoxication, food, exchange, and related actions for SkyrimNet.
description: Adds iActions SkyrimNet prompts and Papyrus-backed actions for NPC drinking, intoxication, sobering, food requests, inventory exchange, stumbling, compliance, and arrow extraction. REQUIRES SkyrimNet Beta 25 or newer for v0.6.6; earlier SkyrimNet versions are unsupported. Also requires SKSE64, JContainers, PO3_SKSEFunctions, and SkyUI. (Upgrading iActions from v0.6.5 does not require a clean install; optional drunk animations are documented by the mod.)
author: phospheneoverdrive
